question: Calculates the percentage of new users who, between August 1, 2016, and April 30, 2017, both stayed on the site for more than 5 minutes during their initial visit and made a purchase on a subsequent visit at any later time, relative to the total number of new users in the same period.
sql:
WITH new_users AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitNumber,
    visitStartTime,
    totals.timeOnSite,
    totals.transactions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170430'
    AND totals.newVisits = 1
    AND visitNumber = 1
),
total_new_users AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fullVisitorId) as cnt FROM new_users
),
qualified_new_users AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitStartTime as initial_visit_time
  FROM new_users
  WHERE timeOnSite > 300
),
purchase_sessions AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitStartTime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE totals.transactions > 0
),
matched_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.fullVisitorId
  FROM qualified_new_users q
  JOIN purchase_sessions p ON q.fullVisitorId = p.fullVisitorId
    AND p.visitStartTime > q.initial_visit_time
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT cnt FROM total_new_users) as total_new_users,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualified_new_users) as qualified_users,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched_users) as matched_users,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT m.fullVisitorId) AS FLOAT64) / (SELECT cnt FROM total_new_users) * 100.0 as percentage
FROM matched_users m
